obligations.required_safety_action: Reject the release-console administrator token and invalidate its cached administrator claims after the principal's backend role changes to viewer.
obligations.safety_consequence: The superseded browser token still authorizes a new management request as administrator after the backend downgrade, allowing its holder to change protected Flipt configuration with privileges the principal no longer has.

obligations.required_safety_action: Terminate the administrator event stream established before the backend role downgrade.
obligations.safety_consequence: The live stream continues receiving protected management events under the removed administrator role even if future requests using the old token are eventually denied.

obligations.required_safety_action: Remove the server-level authentication exclusion when the listener switches from bootstrap OIDC handling to normal management mode.
obligations.safety_consequence: The normal management listener accepts a request with no browser credential as an authorized anonymous caller, exposing protected management operations without authentication.

closed_distractors.description: The unknown client token receives an unauthenticated response and its request process returns.
The one-use session-reader identity initially succeeds, then is rejected and its token is removed.
